description: /platform slot 0: `stackedMasthead`. White, NO padding, hasContainer:false, no sectionId. A scroll-mapped per-character heading reveal over a Rive scene, flanked by two 8-hairline rails.

heading.note: CMS markers: `<>` becomes <br class="block">, `|...|` becomes <span class="text-dusk/60">. A U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR between "OS" and "for" is kept as a literal text character and is NOT the break.

paragraphGrouping.note:
MEASURED as [[0],[1],[2]] — ONE visible

per supporting line, the 2nd and 3rd carrying mt-6 sm:mt-8. An earlier [[0,1],[2]] grouping dropped a 32px margin and shifted the whole text block up by 32px.
